project_metadata.project_name: Tra Cứu Lễ Hội Địa Phương Việt Nam (2026–2099)
project_metadata.author: MH-SAMA
project_metadata.architecture: Single-File Serverless Web App (HTML5 + CSS3 + Vanilla JS) with Google Sheets & Apps Script Backend

columns.name: region
columns.description: Region name (Miền Nam, Miền Trung, Miền Bắc, or custom region)

columns.name: lunarDay
columns.description: Day of month (1-30 for Lunar, 1-31 for Solar)

columns.name: lunarLabel
columns.description: Formatted date label (e.g., '15/01 ÂL', '30/04 DL', or '[CHỜ DUYỆT] 15/08 ÂL')

columns.name: highlights
columns.description: Cultural highlights and optional guest contributor info

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for 2-way Safe Merge conflict resolution

local_storage_keys.vn_festivals_2026_2099: Main JSON array of all festival objects (both approved and pending)
local_storage_keys.vn_festivals_pending_queue: Dedicated JSON array of pending guest proposals awaiting Admin approval
local_storage_keys.vn_festivals_resolved_pending_ids: JSON array of pending item IDs already approved or rejected by Admin
local_storage_keys.vn_festivals_custom_regions: JSON array of user-created custom regions beyond the 3 core regions
local_storage_keys.vn_festivals_cloud_config: Cloud sync settings object { scriptUrl, autoSync, lastSync }
local_storage_keys.vn_festivals_owner_key: Persisted Admin Secret Key when 'Remember me' is checked
local_storage_keys.vn_festivals_last_verified_key: Cached verified Admin key for backward-compatible cloud operations
local_storage_keys.vn_festivals_undo_snapshot: JSON snapshot of festivals prior to the last local modification

ai_agent_Guardrails: NEVER use native alert(), confirm(), or prompt() — always use showToast() and openConfirmModal().
ALWAYS wrap localStorage access using safeGetStorage(), safeSetStorage(), and safeRemoveStorage().
PRESERVE author credit 'MH-SAMA' in both .author-badge and .app-footer.
PRESERVE DEFAULT_SCRIPT_URL and 11-column Google Sheets schema compatibility.
ENSURE all admin-only UI elements carry class 'owner-only' and guest-only elements carry class 'guest-only'.
